title: ANDS Studio — Sign in / create a workspace
walkthrough:
You land on a single centered card with the "ANDS Studio" brand mark at the top. The default heading is "Sign in", with one line of context beneath it: "Your clients' dossiers are isolated per workspace." The form has two fields, "Email" (placeholder "ra@company.example") and "Password". The primary button "Sign in →" stays disabled until both fields are filled; while it processes, its label changes to "Working…". Next to it is a ghost-styled link-button, "New client? Create a workspace", and below the row, "Forgot password?".

Clicking "New client? Create a workspace" flips the same card into signup mode. The heading becomes "Create your workspace" and the subtext reads "One workspace per client company — dossiers, documents and filings stay isolated." A third field appears above Email: "Company / client name" (placeholder "Northbridge Regulatory CRO"). Under the password box, live feedback tracks the rule "At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers." — showing "✓ Meets the password rules." once satisfied, or an ✗ line with a count of how many more characters you need. The primary button is now "Create workspace →", and the secondary reads "Have an account? Sign in".

The reset path ("Forgot password?") retitles the card "Reset your password" and explains: "Enter your account email. We issue a one-time code (expires in 15 minutes) to set a new password." You press "Send me a code →". Because this environment has no email delivery, the code is displayed on screen in a notice ("Your one-time code (shown here because this environment has no email delivery):") — that is how you actually get it. You enter it into a "One-time code" field (placeholder "8-digit code"), type a "New password", and press "Set new password →". On success you return to sign-in with the notice "Password updated — sign in with your new password." A "Back to sign in" button is available throughout. Errors from any action appear as a red notice box on the card.

After sign-in or signup you are routed to the dossier manager. A top bar shows the brand ("ANDS Studio · dossier manager"), a user chip with your email plus your workspace name and a "Sign out" button, and nav chips: "Help", "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence", "Guided journey →". The page heading is "Your product dossiers", with a "New dossier +" button. A fresh workspace shows the empty state "No dossiers yet. Create one to start building a submission." Note that creating a dossier later requires an ID in a specific format — "Dossier ID must be one letter + 6–7 digits (e.g. e123456)" — though a "No ID yet? Start with a placeholder →" option exists.
